result.topic_en: A short note on replacing the Bessel functions in the Voronoi identity with circular functions, at the cost of a more complicated sum, judged probably useless for the divisor problem.
result.transcription:
Idea  You can replace the Bessel f^{ns}[?] of the
V. identity by circular functions, at
the price of complicating the 'sum'
Interesting idea, but prob^y of no value
for the study of the divisor problem
